sweep_specs.law_quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.
missing_inputs: Reviewed Native map, actor and camera evidence for physical sweep feasibility and driver recognition.
physical_checks_pending: actual actor visibility and camera pixels
sweep_specs.rationale: Source-bound CPU engineering samples retain both directions, three 500-foot probes and two crest placements without defining a legal judgment threshold.
